title: The Boundary Realignment
logline: An administrative treaty redrawing sector borders places an independent mining cluster under a predatory customs charter overnight.

roles.description: A rigid customs official tasked with enforcing the new territorial treaty before their jurisdiction review.
Represents the cluster miners; desperate to clear their stockpiled ore before tariffs consume their operational margin.
A high-speed interceptor enforcing the newly established customs cordon.
The newly annexed orbital transfer station collecting tariff levies under the revised sector treaty.
A smelter station in the adjacent system offering fair rates if miners can jump across the contested line.

public_situation: A revised border treaty between neighboring systems reclassified the outer asteroid belt under a monopoly customs tariff. Unlicensed ore runs face immediate seizure.
private_truth: The boundary realignment was signed during peace accords without surveying the actual mining clusters, and the customs prefect must show immediate revenue to keep the cutter station funded.

beats.public_change: Customs beacons deploy along the newly established sector perimeter, declaring all uncertified ore transfers subject to immediate impoundment.

missions.reason: The steward needs a licensed contract pilot to run a test load through the new inspection gate to calculate actual tariff deductions before committing the fleet.
missions.private_fact: She has promised the miners the tariff is manageable, though the draft treaty rates will bankrupt half the independent dredgers.

beats.public_change: The customs authority doubles the transit bond on outbound freight, trapping unrefined ore in the belt.

missions.reason: The steward contracts an unflagged hauler to deliver certified transit seals from the customs depot to allow trapped mining rigs to jump clear.
missions.private_fact: The customs office is deliberately delaying transit seal approvals until the quarterly tax collection window closes.

missions.reason: The prefect hires an outsider to deliver formal impoundment writs to delinquent mining berths before the miners organize a collective departure.
missions.private_fact: The prefect lacks enough enforcement cutters to board the dredgers simultaneously and relies on intimidation to force early settlements.

beats.public_change: A convoy of independent miners attempts a mass transit run across the newly drawn customs line under threat of interception.

missions.reason: The steward needs an armed escort to disable the interceptor cutter guarding the jump gate so the mining fleet can reach the free smelter.
missions.private_fact: The cutter captain offers to let the convoy pass in exchange for a private seizure cut paid from the lead cargo barge.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the customs cutter, clearing the jump gate for the mining fleet.
resolutions.summary: The mining convoy punches through to {role:free_smelter}. {role:customs_prefect} faces an administrative audit, and the contested belt falls outside customs control.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary crippled a customs cutter to let an entire mining fleet jump past an unlawful toll.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the cutter captain's offer during combat, paying off the patrol.
resolutions.summary: The lead miners pay off {role:customs_cutter} and escape, while slower dredgers are seized to pay back-taxes under {role:customs_prefect}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took a cutter captain's split, leaving poorer dredgers behind to pay the tariff.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or fails the breakout.
resolutions.summary: The mining fleet capitulates to {role:consortium_depot}. Independent crews sign indentured repayment bonds, and {role:customs_prefect} secures the sector tariff.

loose_threads.detail: The treaty map posted on the customs board bears an amendment rider signed by a maritime bank that does not operate in this system.
The customs depot tariff schedule lists exemptions for three freighter registries that were dissolved five years ago.

radio_hooks: Customs patrols establish cordon around outer mining cluster under revised border protocol.
Miners in {system} claim new sector boundaries violate century-old prospecting deeds.
Consortium tariff depot reports record early collection revenues following treaty ratification.

voice_direction.customs_prefect: Speaks in rigid legal jargon and cites treaty sub-clauses when challenged. Never acknowledges the financial hardship of the miners.
voice_direction.mining_steward: Blunt, exhausted, and speaks with rapid urgency. Avoids mentioning how close her union treasury is to total insolvency.
